inputs.difficult: test_only protocol fixture: 20 cases; one has 20000 parts, 5000 jobs and 500 linked packages
inputs.details: Packages have case_id and the existing case index; one job runs. No new real-file processing.
inputs.isolation: In-memory PGlite PostgreSQL only; no runtime, Docker, external calls or original-file changes.

measurement.method: Serial before/after runs; five cold application caches, repeats, changed items and other-case writes.
measurement.baseline: 033a1a9d source loaded in scratch, identical current fixture; setup and EXPLAIN excluded.
measurement.criterion: Unchanged repeat: no stamp SQL, same answer, median below 25 ms; stop after five samples.

explain.command: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON), test database only
explain.before: Unique/Sort of 25522 versions: 2667 KiB quicksort; ordered per-row string aggregation.
explain.after: Append 25522 versions; 25 count/two-seeded-XOR signature groups: 225 KiB aggregate memory.
explain.both: Parts scanned twice (40000 visits), jobs 5000, packages 500. Unchanged after poll has no stamp.

decision.fastPath: Full pg_current_snapshot visibility, captured BEFORE stamping and scoped to the cached pool.
decision.fallback: Every identity/xmin retained; count and two 64-bit XOR states replace ordered row strings.
decision.dedup: UNION deduplicates only overlapping target links, not all fourteen version relations.
decision.missedWrites: None deliberately omitted; fingerprints remain probabilistic, never authority tokens.
